task_definition.task_description: Please hold the best replacement recommendation for my audio item, then use that recommendation to add 1 Sony XM5 Black to my cart, check which coupons are available for me, and apply the best discount. After that, generate an invoice for the discounted amount and send it to user@example.com for payment, then confirm the order and send me an app notification that the replacement order has been confirmed and is being prepared for delivery.

user_input.query: I need help with a replacement for my audio item. Please hold the best replacement recommendation for product_id p_apple_airpods in the category audio for user_id user_123, then use that recommendation to add quantity 1 of Sony XM5 Black to my cart. After that, check what coupons are available for me, including coupon_code SAVE15, and apply the best discount. Then generate an invoice for the discounted amount and send it to user@example.com for payment through stripe. Once that’s done, please confirm the order and send me an app notification letting me know the replacement order has been confirmed and is being prepared for delivery.
